title: ynh trust show <folder> --format json
description: Output of `ynh trust show <folder> --format json`, for a harness run from a folder rather than an installed id (see trust-show.schema.json for that). A folder's own commands are not trust-checked; this lists the remote includes that bring commands, each with its state, so they can be reviewed before `ynh trust accept <folder>`. Not enveloped. It changes nothing.

key.description: The include's trust key: its repository, subpath and ref.

ref.description: The ref the include is pinned to; empty when it names none.

sha.description: The commit, present only when ref is a full 40-character SHA.

state.description: unreviewed: never accepted; accepted: its commands match what was accepted; changed: they differ.

commands.description: How many commands the include executes.

includes.description: Each remote include of the folder that brings commands; empty when there are none.
